name: Continuous user journey
description: Let a persistent persona observe, choose one safe next action, retain evidence and feelings, and evolve its intent across visits.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Browser base URL
parameters.tooltip: Public URL that Playwright opens while collecting browser evidence.

parameters.label: User perspective
parameters.tooltip: The user perspective that guides the simulated journey and its decisions.

parameters.label: Ongoing goal
parameters.placeholder: e.g. understand whether I can complete my first task safely
parameters.tooltip: The concrete outcome the critical flow should prove with retained evidence.

parameters.label: What to learn
parameters.default: clarity, safe next actions, and friction
parameters.placeholder: e.g. clear recovery from a failed checkout
parameters.tooltip: The product behavior or experience that the repeated journey should prioritize.

parameters.label: AI model profile
parameters.tooltip: Select an existing AI model profile, or create one for this build.

runner.name: ${build_name} autonomous persona runner
runner.description: Let a persistent persona observe, choose one safe next action, retain evidence and feelings, and evolve its intent across visits.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Review rendered evidence for ${focus}. Preserve user safety, explain evidence, and propose only reversible improvements.

cases.name: ${persona}
cases.prompt: As ${persona}, pursue this goal over repeated visits: ${goal}. ${focus}.
cases.acceptance: Retain rendered evidence and a specific next check; do not claim success without a visible result.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Let a persistent persona observe, choose one safe next action, retain evidence and feelings, and evolve its intent across visits.
